answer_options.text: The camera wearer will likely focus on organizing construction materials, moving boxes, marking metal with a marker and a pen, and double-checking measurements.

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer places pipes in wooden boxes, moves boxes on the ground, handles metal parts in boxes, opens boxes, picks bolts from a toolbox, draws on metal plates with a pen and marker, and marks metal with a marker and a pen. The camera wearer also picks up and places metal rods and pipe joints on metal plates.
